ABSOLUTELY NO TEXT, words, letters, logos or labels anywhere in the image, except the DentalPULSE wordmark printed on the Pod itself. Leave calm empty space in the top third (for an email headline added later). The DentalPULSE Pod (white ribbed dome from the first reference image) RESTS on a surface, nobody holds it; compact, about 13 cm wide. Any appliance is about half the Pod's width. A clean denture has bright white teeth and fresh pink gums.
